article.en: On Wednesday evening, we went to the Town Hall.
article.zh: 星期三的晚上，我们去了市政厅。

article.en: It was the last day of the year.
A large crowd of people had gathered under the Town Hall clock.
article.zh: 一大群人聚集在市政厅的大钟下面。

article.en: It would strike twelve in twenty minutes.
article.zh: 再过二十分钟，大钟将敲响十二下。

article.en: Fifteen minutes passed and then, at five to twelve, the clock stopped.
article.zh: 十五分钟过去了，而就在差五分十二点时，大钟停了。

article.en: The big minute hand did not move.
article.zh: 那根巨大的分针不动了。

article.en: We waited and waited, but nothing happened.
article.zh: 我们等啊等啊，可情况没有变化。

article.en: Suddenly someone shouted, 'It is two minutes past twelve! The clock has stopped!'
article.zh: 突然有人喊道：“已经十二点过两分了！那钟已经停了！”

article.en: I looked at my watch and it was true.
article.zh: 我看了一下我的手表，果真如此。

article.en: The big clock refused to welcome the New Year, but everybody began to laugh and sing.
article.zh: 那座大钟不愿意迎接新年，但此时大家都笑了起来，同时唱起了歌。
